description: High-resolution, large-scale laboratory measurements of a sandy beach and dynamic cobble berm revetment is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Chris E. Blenkinsopp et al. High quality laboratory measurements of nearshore waves and morphology change at, or near prototype-scale are essential to support new understanding of coastal processes and enable the development and validation of predictive models. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2021. Formats: MATLAB. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 6223 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
